experiment: P4f detached shallow-multiscale SawFM-period safe fallback
research_question: Do local MLCNN stages 1--3 contain enough period texture to correct SawFM sweep-period negative transfer without modifying the classifier or the other 11 routed parameters?

mechanism.single_change_vs_baseline: replace only SawFM sweep-period with a compact scalar head over detached pooled I/Q outputs from MLCNN stages 1--3
mechanism.single_change_vs_failed_p4e: move the safe head input from the final classification embedding to shallow multi-scale local features
mechanism.gradient_contract: the fallback cannot update any MLCNN convolution or classification parameter
mechanism.other_parameter_contract: the other 11 outputs remain on the IQ-Grouped parameter route

prior_evidence_boundary.p4e_seed690000000: failure attribution only; not used for training or threshold selection
prior_evidence_boundary.p4d_seeds: external confirmation and failure attribution only; not reused
prior_evidence_boundary.older_shallow_screen: supports feature sufficiency hypothesis only; no checkpoint or threshold is reused

training.paired_batch_order: same model seed uses an independently seeded DataLoader generator

stop_rule: Do not tune on seed700000000. Failure stops detached learned fallback variants; success requires two new no-tuning generator seeds before promotion.
next_if_pass: Freeze P4f and perform two external generator-seed confirmations, then strict MAC matching.
